newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Petrobras opens new oil platform.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Petrobras opens new oil platform.

text.p: Brazilian state-owned oil giant Petrobras has started production of 20,000 barrels of oil per day (BPD) at a new oil platform off the coast of Rio de Janeiro state, the company said.
Petrobras said the new platform Petrobras 25 was important for the company's goal of achieving output of 900,000 bpd by November this year.

Petrobras 25 is expected to increase its production to 60,000 bpd next month and to 100,000 bpd by the end of the year, Petrobras said in a statement. The platform will operate at full capacity of 112,000 bpd by April 1997.

The platform, which is located 192 km from Macae in the Albacora oilfield in waters 575 meters deep, also has the capacity to produce 3.25 million cubic meters of natural gas per day. The Albacora oilfield currently produces 55,000 bpd.
The platform is part of a 750 million reais investment expected to generate financial returns in two and a half years.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
